note: The roll slider in the 2D view now draws a wireframe, the way desktop OpenRocket does: while the view is rolled every fin is a plain outline over the body, nothing hidden and nothing occluded, so all of them are on screen at every angle and one fin can be followed the whole way round - including through the angle where it turns edge-on. At rest the drawing is unchanged: the filled one, with a fin in front of the airframe drawn whole and one behind it cut at the wall. No numbers change.
